integrity: All principal polynomial identities and exact-rational strict inequalities were checked from the packaged checker.py; completeness is supplied by the manuscript proof, not finite sampling. Independent mathematical audit and validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed first-three Hermite modes; one-dimensional half-line cutoff and an explicitly normalized threshold. No classification for other rank or geometries. title: Five stationary thresholds and a unique centered maximum for three-Hermite half-line concentration
